description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

ECS Ltd is hiring a Junior Software Developer to contribute to the development of custom business applications across the full stack. The role includes building web services, supporting application architecture, implementing DevOps strategies, and helping scale platforms.
Junior Software Developer building business applications, integrating web services, and improving application reliability and deployment automation

Responsibilities:
• Participate in the project lifecycle by designing, storyboarding, prototyping, developing, testing, deploying, and implementing custom business applications using the latest tools and technologies
• Build modern web services to integrate with various internal and external services and APIs
• Support our application architecture to improve logging, error handling, and performance
• Implement DevOps strategies to improve automation and reduce waste
• Help scale our platforms as we grow
• Stay current with emerging technologies and trends
• Assist in the contribution and enhancement of assigned ECS projects
• Develop an understanding of ECS domain knowledge and development best practices

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or related discipline; or equivalent work experience
• 0-5 years with a degree or 2-5 years without a degree of experience as a developer using the Microsoft technology stack

Preferred:
• Certifications in Microsoft Development, Agile Development and Microsoft SQL Server
